Package com.egradx.auth.oidc

Class EgradxOidcSignInProvider

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.oidc.EgradxOidcSignInProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
EgradxSignInProvider
Direct Known Subclasses:
EgradxGoogleSignInProvider, EgradxZohoSignInProvider
public class EgradxOidcSignInProvider extends Object implements EgradxSignInProvider
Any OpenID Connect provider: the authorization code flow with PKCE, state and nonce, and the ID token checked against the provider's published keys (EgradxOidcClient). Configured with type: oidc (the default), an issuer and a client.

A provider with something particular to it extends this class and overrides what differs — see EgradxGoogleSignInProvider (its defaults) and EgradxZohoSignInProvider (its data centres).
